name: Systeme.io
summary: All-in-one platform for online businesses that combines sales funnels, email marketing, online courses, a website builder and an affiliate program, with a free plan for up to 2,000 contacts.
best_for: solo creators, coaches and small online businesses that want funnels, email, courses and an affiliate program under one login, and are happy to start free and move up as the contact list grows
skip_if: you need a deep sales CRM, you want a tool we have tested on a paid plan, you already run funnels, email and courses on tools you like, or your list is far past 10,000 contacts and you want to see the Unlimited price first
honest_knock: Plans are metered on contacts, so the bill steps from $0 to $17, $47 and $97 as the list grows, and the free plan allows only 1 automation rule, 1 email campaign and $10,000 in total sales. The page does not print the annual total, only that it gives 2 months free. In our test (18 Nov 2026) a new funnel went live on the default subdomain at once, and Free pages carried a "Powered by systeme.io" badge. We have not paid for a plan, so email delivery at scale is unknown to us.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Startup · per month for 5,000 contacts, 10 funnels and 5 courses
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-18 on systeme.io/pricing, US dollars a month; earlier: read 2026-11-17) Free $0: 2,000 contacts, 3 sales funnels with 15 funnel steps, 1 website, 1 blog, 1 course, 1 affiliate program, 1 custom domain, 1 automation rule, 1 workflow, 1 tag, 1 CRM pipeline, 1 email campaign, 500 students, no evergreen webinars, no card. The page structured data says Free processes up to $10,000 in total sales, then gives 3 days to upgrade to keep accepting payments, and that accounts with no login or activity for 6 months are deactivated. Startup $17: 5,000 contacts, 10 funnels, 5 courses. Webinar $47: 10,000 contacts, 50 funnels, 20 courses, evergreen webinars. Unlimited $97: unlimited contacts, funnels, courses and automation rules. All plans: unlimited email sends, unlimited sub-accounts, 0% transaction fees. Annual billing is offered with 2 months free; the page prints no yearly total. A team tier is sold by call. In our test (18 Nov 2026) a new funnel was Active and public on the default systeme.io subdomain at once, the opt-in form refused addresses on a domain with no MX or A record, the templates offered were website templates with lorem ipsum text and no opt-in template, and Free pages showed "Powered by systeme.io". We have not paid for a plan.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 18 November 2026 the session tested the Free plan of Systeme.io in our new workspace (an earlier attempt had stopped on a 403 page). A funnel from a template with a changed headline was ready in about 6 minutes, and an automation rule (form subscribed, add a tag) and a course with a module and a lecture were made quickly. The 18 templates are generic website templates with lorem ipsum, none for an e-book or opt-in; a new funnel is Active and public at once on the default subdomain, and the Free plan shows Powered by systeme.io. The opt-in with a made-up address was refused because its domain has no MX or A record, so no contact was tested, and a campaign cannot be made without a sender address, so no email was tested. The prices match the dossier; the dossier does not list several Free limits (1 tag, 1 pipeline, 1 workflow, 1 website, 1 blog, 15 funnel steps, 0 evergreen webinars, 1 custom domain, a sales revenue limit of 10000 USD), and the rule and tag counters were used up after one opt-in flow. The test funnel, course and tag were deleted. No plan was bought. Account and start: an account existed (created by us) and the test ran in our new workspace on the Free plan, in our own tab of his browser. An earlier attempt the same morning had stopped: the dashboard then gave 403 Forbidden because the account had only an affiliate profile and no business workspace; nothing was created in that attempt and the affiliate dashboard was not touched. The test described here started at 11:09 and ended at about 11:45 on the dashboard of the new workspace (menus Dashboard, CRM, Sites, Emails, SMS, Automations, Assets, Sales). The interface was first in Dutch and was switched to English through the language button at the top right; at the end it was set back to Dutch (the last click was not checked on screen). The dashboard showed 1 new lead in total, which was not touched. The dossier name is Systeme.io and the review is on MSS (systeme-io-review); the handson folder and the review slug are the same. Core action: the funnel. Sites, Funnels, Create opens one dialog (name, funnel domain on the default subdomain, four cards Build an audience, Sell, Custom and Run an evergreen webinar, currency). The card Build an audience was chosen with the name Test Co E-book Opt-in and the result was a funnel with two steps, Opt-in page and Thank You / Download Page. The funnel was at once Active, so it was public on the default subdomain with no publish step. The template step shows 9 templates a page on 2 pages: generic website templates for a non-profit, a law firm, a museum and a pet clinic, full of lorem ipsum, and none for an e-book, an opt-in magnet or a sales page; the first one was used because it has an email field and a button. The editor opens in the same tab in about 3 seconds; the headline was changed to Get the free Test Co e-book (triple click, type, Save) and that worked at once. The public page shows the fixed badge Powered by systeme.io at the bottom right and Built with systeme.io in the footer on the Free plan; whether a paid plan removes them was not tested. The button View funnel step opens a new tab and was not clicked; the page was opened by address in our own tab. Opt-in: a placeholder address on the example.com domain was typed in and the field turned red with This email address is invalid and can't receive emails because its domain lacks a valid MX or A DNS record. So the form checks the email domain for real, which is good, but it also means a made-up address cannot be used for a test. The opt-in was skipped and no contact was added. Automation: Automation Rules, Add rule, trigger Funnel step form subscribed (funnel and step filled in), action Add a tag, with the new tag ebook-optin, Save rule; the rule then shows as Active. Other actions are Subscribe to campaign, Send email, Send email to a specific email address, Send SMS, Add tag, Remove tag and Add to a pipeline stage; the triggers are Funnel step form subscribed and Page visited. Email: Emails, Campaigns, Create asks for a Name, a Sender email address (required) and a Description. The sender list said nothing here yet and No options, with a link to add and verify a new email address. That was a blocker: adding a sender means typing a real address and verifying it, which was not done. No campaign and no newsletter was made or sent. Course: Assets, Courses, Create (Add a new course: Name, Domain, URL Path, Color theme). The course Test Co Mini Course was made with Module 1 and the lecture Lesson 1: Welcome (2 lecture templates, Delay before unlock 0). It stayed Inactive. Time to the first result (a funnel from a template with a changed headline): about 6 minutes and more than 7 steps. Screens loaded in 2 to 4 seconds. Plans, read on Settings, Billing, My plan (nothing was clicked on Upgrade plan): Free $0 a month (current plan), Startup $17, Webinar $47 and Unlimited $97 a month, with a Monthly and Yearly switch that says 2 months free. Limits per plan (Free, Startup, Webinar, Unlimited): contacts 2000, 5000, 10000, Unlimited; tags 1, 10, 100, Unlimited; calendar events 1, 5, 20, Unlimited; pipelines 1, 5, 20, Unlimited; automation rules 1, 10, 100, Unlimited; workflows 1, 5, 20, Unlimited; sales funnels 3, 10, 50, Unlimited; funnel steps 15, 50, 300, Unlimited; evergreen webinars 0, 0, 10, Unlimited; A/B tests 1, 10, 50, Unlimited; one-click upsells 1, 10, 100, Unlimited; order bumps 1, 10, 100, Unlimited; websites 1, 5, 20, Unlimited; languages per website 2, Unlimited, Unlimited, Unlimited; blogs 1, 5, 20, Unlimited; custom domains 1, 3, 10, Unlimited; campaigns 1, 10, 100, Unlimited; link in bio 1, 3, 10, Unlimited; link in bio products 3, 15, 50, Unlimited; physical product variants 50, 100, 250, Unlimited; coupon codes 1, 10, 50, Unlimited; sales revenue limit 10000 USD, then Unlimited; courses 1, 5, 20, Unlimited; students 500, Unlimited, Unlimited, Unlimited; communities 1, 5, 20, Unlimited. After one simple opt-in flow the Free counters for automation rules (1/1) and tags (1/1) were already used up. Deviations from the dossier: the prices ($0, $17, $47, $97), the contacts, funnels and courses per plan, the 2 months free on yearly payment and the Free allowance of 1 automation rule, 1 email campaign and 500 students match. The dossier does not list the other Free limits: 1 tag, 1 pipeline, 1 workflow, 1 A/B test, 1 website, 1 blog, 1 custom domain, a sales revenue limit of 10000 USD, 15 funnel steps and 0 evergreen webinars. The claim of unlimited email sends could not be tested because no sender could be added. The price fields of our pages are not touched. Checkout: NOT reached. No Upgrade plan button was clicked, so no tax, total, card or payment screen was seen. Cancelling: the account is on the Free plan with no subscription, and the account was not deleted. Not tested: an opt-in with a real address, a contact in the list, writing or sending an email or a campaign (a sender is needed), Newsletters, evergreen webinars, paid functions, an own domain, Stripe and PayPal, integrations, the affiliate dashboard (not touched), and the group Growing lists between 5,000 and 10,000 contacts. Clean up: the funnel Test Co E-book Opt-in (with its rule) was deleted and confirmed, and its public address then gave 404; the course Test Co Mini Course (with module and lecture) and the tag ebook-optin were deleted. No test contact, no campaign and no email exist. The tab was closed; the account and our existing contact (1 of 2000) were not touched.
exit_test.awkward: The templates are generic website templates with lorem ipsum, none for an e-book or opt-in, so you have to rebuild one yourself. A new funnel is Active at once and public on the default subdomain with no publish step. The Free plan shows Powered by systeme.io. The rule and tag counters (1 of 1) were used up after one simple opt-in flow, so a welcome series and a second segment do not fit, and a campaign needs a verified sender address before it can be made. The opt-in refuses a made-up address.

friction.export_route: No export or reimport was performed; no file was downloaded or examined. The two categorised kit records were not entered; the objects tested were not kit records.

not_tested: An opt-in with a real address, a contact in the list, writing or sending an email, a campaign or a newsletter (a sender address is needed).
Evergreen webinars, paid functions, an own domain, Stripe and PayPal and integrations.
The affiliate dashboard, which was not touched.
The group growing lists between 5,000 and 10,000 contacts.
Checkout, a paid plan and cancelling.
Export and reimport.

Session and source-reading date: 18 November 2026. Times are CET. The session started at about 11:09 CET. These are approximate tester observations, not benchmark timings. Midnight timestamps are required date anchors, not measured event times.
exit_test.note: A check of this export route with synthetic records, on the account and date stated. Re-importing the export was not tested. The exported file was not opened, so what it contains is unverified. Friction is described, not scored; this is not a verdict on the product.
